brief: Concept: the calm of a natural-stone home, made easy. Slide 1 uses the official Shopify lifestyle photo of Travertine Stone Ivory In Out; slides 2 to 4 use close-up showroom photography of the actual tile in soft daylight. Keep the ivory tone true: no warm filters or added saturation. Note for review: this product has no slip rating in Shopify, so the copy deliberately makes no outdoor or slip claims; confirm with Wade before adding any.
caption:
Ivory stone, soft light, slow weekends.

Travertine Stone Ivory In Out brings the authentic veining and tonal variation of natural travertine to porcelain, without the upkeep. A 600 × 600 mm tile that feels at home in Coastal, Hamptons and Japandi interiors.

Save this for your renovation shortlist, and come and see it in person at our Herston showroom.
